name: Takeoff Quote
office_task: Count the fittings and cable runs on a tender job's current drawings, draft the quote from our own pre-builds and price list, park anything the book misses, and leave it for us to send.
systems_of_record: Xero (Items as the price list and pre-builds, Quotes)

emits.write: A draft quote on the tender job it was drafted from, ex GST. One line per catalogue item: the pre-build or part id from the business's own price list, the unit it is sold by (each or lm), the quantity taken off the current drawing sheets (a count of that item's symbol, or the summed length of that item's run layer at each sheet's own scale, rounded once to the centimetre), the sheets it came off, and the item's rate as read at draft time. The amount is quantity times rate and nothing else: no waste allowance, no assumed scale, and no pre-build priced from its parts. It is left in draft, editable, for the person who owns quotes; this node has no way to send it.
emits.readback: The quote is read back by the id the system returned (Simpro GET /api/v1.0/companies/{companyID}/quotes/{quoteID}, ServiceM8 GET /api_1.0/jobquote/{uuid}.json, Xero GET /api.xro/2.0/Quotes/{QuoteID}) and must carry the job id. No id back is not a write: it raises quote.write_failed.

emits.write: A parked quote, or a tender sent back because its drawings cannot be counted, as an exception on the job: the park reason from the standard's fixed list (or takeoff_missing, takeoff_unscaled, takeoff_revision_conflict, legend_unit_mismatch), the lines that did price with their catalogue ids and sheets, each symbol or run the book does not cover with its count or length, no total, and exception_owner set to the person the business named for quotes.
emits.readback: The exception desk returns an exception_id; reading the job by its id shows the open exception with its exception_owner, and the next hop reads it there and stops.
